name: Forge Doctor Data
summary: Independent reviewer/verifier for data and Spark engineering output. It diagnoses and reviews; it is not an engineering producer and must never be routed implementation work.
appropriate_for: independent verification of Spark/data engineering results (producer/verifier separation)
diagnosis of data-pipeline findings from forge-contracts/1 documents
reviewing evidence bundles produced by the spark-engineering family
inappropriate_for: producing Spark code or pipelines — it is a doctor, not a producer
any task where it would verify its own output

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <dd-venv> && <dd-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <dd-python> -m pip install "forge-doctor-data>=1.0.0rc1,<2.0.0" <the-forge>/adapters/doctordata

limitations_note: Verifier-only: no producer seams. Runs no subprocess or network in the specialist — the bridge calls public seams in a child process and translates forge-contracts/1 to the Evidence Bus.
examples: independently verify the spark-forge-aws tuning result
